column4: Sumerian was the first language to be written: cuneiform began in Uruk around 3200 BCE as pictures drawn in clay and became wedge-shaped signs for words and syllables.

column2: The cuneiform of Sumer, from the accounts of Uruk to the hymns and laws of the Third Dynasty of Ur; long after Sumerian died out as a spoken language it was copied in the schools of Babylon.

Type a Sumerian word (lugal, king; e2 or é, house) or syllables joined by hyphens (ki-en-gi). Numbers or accents give the index of a value: e2 = é, du3 = dù. A determinative goes in braces before the word: {d}en-lil2 is the god Enlil. h is ḫ and sh is š.
